channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Elgin Baylor | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Elgin Baylor from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Julius Erving on Jerry West, Oscar Robertson, Elgin Baylor, Bill Russell
item.description:
Julius Erving:

“I picked my top five when I was 15 years old. I have not let anybody mess that up. I went with Chamberlain and Bill Russell, Elgin Baylor, Jerry West, and Oscar Robertson. When you are 15 years old and you see those five out there, that's permanent.”

Julius Erving on Jerry West, Oscar Robertson, Elgin Baylor, Bill Russell, Oct 6, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Julius Erving on Jerry West, Oscar Robertson, Elgin Baylor, Wilt Chamberlain, Bill Russell
item.description:
In an interview with Joy DeAngela,Julius Erving named the top 10 players he thinks are the best in basketball history.

“I have five guys who are untouchable - Bill Russell, Wilt Chamberlain, Oscar Robertson, Jerry West, and Elgin Baylor.,”

Julius Erving on Jerry West, Oscar Robertson, Elgin Baylor, Wilt Chamberlain, Bill Russell, Jul 30, 2023. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Elgin Baylor
item.description:
“For a player like Luka, doing something that’s never been done before — it’s hard to do. There’s been some great players before him. ... Elgin Baylor, Wilt — he was in that class, and then he separated himself and made his own class, which is pretty cool.”

Jason Kidd on Elgin Baylor, Dec 28, 2022. Source: Dallas Morning News.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Elgin Baylor
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Pop on growing up watching Elgin Baylor:

“(He) played a game that at the time nobody could handle. He was really fun to watch. I was a young guy and just watching him play with all his feints and fakes and double-pumps and everything. He was different from everybody else.”

Gregg Popovich on Elgin Baylor, Mar 22, 2021. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Magic Johnson on Elgin Baylor
item.description:
Lakers legend@Magic Johnson on the great Elgin Baylor:

“I really believe he was really the first Showtime. He was Showtime before Showtime. I think we just followed his lead. He was Showtime before Showtime and I want to give him that love and respect because it’s true.”

Magic Johnson on Elgin Baylor, Mar 22, 2021. Source: Twitter @BA_Turner.

item.title: Pat Riley on Elgin Baylor
item.description:
Mark Medina:Pat Riley on Elgin Baylor's passing:

“Besides being one of the greatest players in the history of the game,Elgin Baylor was one of the classiest, most dignified men of integrity I have ever met. He will be missed.”

Pat Riley on Elgin Baylor, Mar 22, 2021. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: Clyde Drexler on LeBron James, Michael Jordan, Jerry West, Larry Bird, Oscar Robertson, Elgin Baylor, Julius Erving, George Gervin
item.description:
Drexler also offered up suggestions on a handful of other NBA greats.

“And then you've got guys like Dr. J [Julius Erving], Larry Bird, George Gervin, Elgin Baylor, Oscar Robertson, Jerry West. All those guys are in the conversation,and so for people to bring this up today, to me it's just unbelievable. And I love Michael and LeBron. But still, let's not take something away from those other guys who played.”

Clyde Drexler on LeBron James, Michael Jordan, Jerry West, Larry Bird, Oscar Robertson, Elgin Baylor, Julius Erving, George Gervin, May 29, 2020. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Spencer Haywood on Elgin Baylor
item.description:
“It was just great because I was with one of my heroes Elgin Baylor who was the coach and playing with “Pistol Pete”

Spencer Haywood on Elgin Baylor, Dec 16, 2018. Source: Deseret News.

item.title: Jerry West on Elgin Baylor
item.description:
Ryan Ward:Jerry West on Elgin Baylor:

“This is one of the greatest men I’ve ever met in my life.”

Jerry West on Elgin Baylor, Apr 6, 2018. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Jeanie Buss on Elgin Baylor
item.description:
Jeanie Buss on Elgin Baylor getting a statue outside of the @STAPLESCenter:

“I am thrilled that 60 years after the Minneapolis Lakers drafted Elgin, we are able to celebrate & honor him with a statue.”

Jeanie Buss on Elgin Baylor, Jan 16, 2018. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Magic Johnson on Elgin Baylor
item.description:
“And now we all feel bad that we didn't support [Baylor], because we should have,”

Magic Johnson on Elgin Baylor, May 14, 2014. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: Oscar Robertson on Michael Jordan, Jerry West, Elgin Baylor, Wilt Chamberlain, Bill Russell
item.description:
Robertson told the Dan Sileo Show on WDAE in Tampa Wednesday morning.

“Let me tell you about what being great is. Ever hear of Elgin Baylor? Never mention his name, do we? Great basketball player. You know what you have today? Michael Jordan was a great player, but he won after Chicago got Pippen, Grant and those other players to go along with him, because for a while they couldn’t beat Detroit.“Everybody looks at what you’ve done. Sure he won six championships, Russell won eleven. There are other players on these teams when they play. They don’t play by themselves. Michael Jordan is a great player. Was he the greatest? Ask Kobe that. Ask Bill Russell. Ask Oscar Robertson. Ask Wilt Chamberlain. Ask Elgin Baylor, Jerry West, ask those guys.”

Oscar Robertson on Michael Jordan, Jerry West, Elgin Baylor, Wilt Chamberlain, Bill Russell, Jun 8, 2011. Source: Sporting News.
